verdict.rationale: Pipedream MCP exposes a documented public API/protocol surface (MCP endpoints, SSE/streamable HTTP transports, per-app dedicated servers, header-based auth like x-pd-external-user-id, proxy endpoints for uncovered API calls) with extensive first-party docs and example code for driving it programmatically from an agent. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond Pipedream's own documentation.
